title: Reading Section C 仔细阅读 1
paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 02
passage:
Every new technology that enters education seems to attract the same argument. Supporters say it will help students who are struggling; critics say it will make them lazy. AI tutoring tools are no exception. These programs can answer questions in clear language, explain a grammar point for the tenth time without losing patience, and give a student immediate feedback at midnight. For learners in places where good tutors are expensive or far away, that is a serious advantage. Studies of basic mathematics and language practice suggest that students who use such tools regularly do improve their test scores, especially when the tool is used for short, focused sessions.

The doubts begin elsewhere. A machine can produce a confident answer that is simply wrong, and a student who has not learned to check may accept it. There is also a quieter worry: if a program always supplies the next step, students may never experience the struggle that teaches them how to think. Teachers report that some students now submit work that is grammatically flawless but strangely empty, as if no one had an opinion behind it.

Most experts therefore draw a sensible line. AI can explain, test and remind; it cannot care whether the student understands. The human teacher remains the person who notices a silent pupil, changes the plan halfway through a lesson and asks the question that makes a class think. In that division of labour, the machine is useful only if the teacher is in charge.

questions.q: What advantage of AI tutoring tools is mentioned?
options: They can give immediate feedback at any time.
They replace the need for human teachers.
They are always cheaper than books.
They help students make friends online.
questions.explain: 第一段说 AI 工具 can ... give a student immediate feedback at midnight，即为学生随时提供即时反馈，故选 A。

questions.q: What do the studies of basic mathematics and language practice suggest?
options: Students should use AI for very long sessions.
Regular short sessions with such tools improve test scores.
AI tools are useless for language learning.
Test scores fall when AI tools are used.
questions.explain: 第一段提到 students who use such tools regularly do improve their test scores, especially when the tool is used for short, focused sessions，故选 B。

questions.q: What is the quieter worry mentioned in the passage?
options: AI tools may cost too much money.
Students may never experience the struggle that teaches them to think.
Teachers may lose their jobs immediately.
questions.explain: 第二段说 if a program always supplies the next step, students may never experience the struggle that teaches them how to think，故选 C。

questions.q: What line do most experts draw?
options: AI should replace teachers in large classes.
AI should be used only in mathematics.
AI should be banned from schools.
AI can explain, test and remind, but the teacher must stay in charge.
questions.explain: 末段说 AI can explain, test and remind; it cannot care whether the student understands，并强调 the machine is useful only if the teacher is in charge，故选 D。
